title: Complaint
description: ENG-01 new contract for the existing SA object. Source: SA 05/SM-04 (案件與補救雙軌) 與 05.1 BR-16/17. A Complaint is never the same object as a remedy action or a refund; closing a Complaint is always an explicit, separately-authored command (resolveComplaint), never an automatic side effect of any RemedyAction/Refund reaching a terminal state (backlog ENG-01 acceptance: 退款完成不會使 Complaint 自動結案).

case_id.description: Exactly one owning Case (ADR 0001: Complaint 關聯 Case／Order).

order_id.description: Optional link to the Order the complaint is about; not every complaint is order-scoped (e.g. pre-sale service complaints).

status.description: SA SM-04 state set, unchanged by this SD round. ESCALATED/REOPENED are sub-states layered onto the main sequence, matching SA's own notation rather than inventing a parallel flag.

verification_state.description: A Complaint may be opened before verification (SA 05 受理); reading private order data or executing a remedy requires VERIFIED first.

customer_statements.description: What the customer said, kept distinct from confirmed_facts (SA 05: 陳述不自動等於事實).

confirmed_facts.description: case_evidence references used to establish facts (sales_order.contract_snapshot, payment, on-site record) per SA 05 證據.

remedy_action_refs.description: RemedyAction objects selected for this complaint (full RemedyAction/Refund/CreditGrant schema is ENG-07 scope; here only the reference shape is fixed). A RemedyAction reaching SUCCEEDED/FAILED/UNKNOWN never implies a status change on this Complaint by itself.

resolution.description: Present only once resolveComplaint has actually run. Its presence is the only thing that can move status to RESOLVED/CLOSED.

unresolved_items.description: SA 05 結案: 未解事項有理由；customer 無回覆不可寫滿意，退款 pending 不關成已解決. Empty array is a valid explicit statement that nothing is outstanding.

customer_responded.description: Must not be inferred as true from silence (SA 05).
